test_run_header.benchmark_objective: A/B Test Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60) vs Weighted Linear Fusion (WLF, alpha=0.6) on 20 queries

system_architecture_snapshot.pipeline_stage: Stage 5: Hybrid Fusion Layer (RRF vs WLF A/B Testing)

winner_decision.engineering_justification: 1. Parameter-Free Robustness: RRF requires zero hyperparameter tuning (k=60 is universally robust across query lengths). In contrast, WLF requires tuning alpha (0.6 is good for general queries, but suboptimal when queries shift between keyword-heavy ticker questions and conceptual narratives). 2. Score Distribution Immunity: WLF's Min-Max normalization is susceptible to outlier BM25 scores (e.g., when a rare query term triggers a 30+ BM25 score, compressing all other candidate scores to near 0). RRF is completely immune to score scaling distortions since it relies exclusively on monotonic rank order. 3. Execution Performance: RRF demonstrated lower latency and avoids two Min-Max scans per query.
winner_decision.when_to_prefer_wlf: WLF should be selected only when adaptive routing dynamically adjusts alpha per query intent (e.g., alpha=0.85 for summarization/conceptual questions, alpha=0.25 for exact financial table / ticker lookups).

On June 24, 2024, the Commission announced that it had opened an additional formal investigation against the Company regarding whether the Company’s new contractual requirements for third-party app developers and app marketplaces may violate the DMA (“Article 6(4) Investigation”). The weakening of foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar adversely affects the U.S. dollar value of the Company’s foreign currency–denominated sales and earnings, and generally leads the Company to raise international pricing, potentially reducing demand for the Company’s products.
